authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party current Music staff business email for an asset-free process inquiry
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Send only a concise asset-free inquiry asking for KSDT’s current airplay, playlist or review submission procedure. Do not attach audio or include private track links until KSDT confirms an authorized delivery method.

businessContact.emailStatus: verified first-party current Music contact published in plaintext on KSDT Radio’s official About page
businessContact.verification: The official About page identifies Sabrina Arruda under Music and publishes sabrina@ksdt.org. The address has valid syntax, uses KSDT’s station-branded domain and is explicitly associated with the Music role. It is not classified as authorization to email music because the page publishes no submission policy. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: KSDT’s official homepage publishes active 2026 music coverage, including an April 1, 2026 live review and recurring January–March 2026 Fresh Picks and Pop Drop new-release features; the About page lists the current operating team.

genreFitEvidence: The official homepage actively covers new music, album reviews, live performances and artist interviews.
Recent and recurring coverage includes electronic, experimental, hip-hop, pop, indie and crossover releases.
Selected clean MarcsMusic electronic, bass, reggae-adjacent, hip-hop-adjacent and global-fusion releases have plausible editorial or airplay fit, subject to KSDT’s unpublished current criteria.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KSDT’s official About page publishes Sabrina Arruda as the current Music contact and provides a public station-domain mailbox, but the page does not explicitly authorize unsolicited audio delivery or publish attachment-versus-link rules, accepted formats, file-size limits, metadata or EPK requirements, release windows, international eligibility, clean or explicit-content rules, AI-origin policy, response times or physical-delivery instructions. A human must recheck the current role holder, send only a concise asset-free process inquiry, wait for explicit delivery instructions, permission-check the selected release and avoid parallel outreach to general, programming, media, events or other staff contacts.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch was searched separately for KSDT, KSDT Radio, the canonical website domain, the station email domain, the current Music contact mailbox and the About path. No previous music-submission-agent platform or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The current Music contact is stored as one inquiry route. General management, programming, media, events, creative, audio, news, sports and other staff contacts are excluded as parallel submission methods.

notes: One new free-first Music department process-inquiry route was queued as needs_manual_review. No audio-delivery method was inferred and no outbound action was taken.
